SHIN_GETTER.title: Shin Getter
SHIN_GETTER.description:
A super robot capable of switching between three forms.
Guided by Getter Rays, it reaches the Spire and heads toward the end of evolution.
SHIN_GETTER.goldMonologue: [sine]Tch. A good citizen would not need this junk anyway.[/sine]
SHIN_GETTER.aromaPrinciple: [sine][red]This is no time to worry about physics.[/red][/sine]
SHIN_GETTER.cardsModifierDescription: Shin Getter cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
SHIN_GETTER.eventDeathPrevention: At least... leave Getter's flame... to the future--
SHIN_GETTER.unlockText: Unlock by completing the requirement for {Prerequisite}.
SHIN_GETTER.banter.dead.endTurnPing: Now you get to see hell too.
SHIN_GETTER.voice.combineBlind: Sorry! We can [gold]combine[/gold] even with our eyes closed!
SHIN_GETTER.voice.oraOraOra: Take this, take this, take this!
SHIN_GETTER.voice.returnTheFavor: Let me return the favor in full!
SHIN_GETTER.voice.roar: うおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおおお
SHIN_GETTER.voice.stayToTheEnd: Tch! Sorry, but you're staying with me to the very end!
SHIN_GETTER.voice.supersonic: This is combat beyond the speed of [white]sound[/white]!
